_notes: Funnel for Homecare Aide Services (owner Aida Bernal), Sonoma and Marin County, CA.
Speaks to families arranging in-home care for someone, usually a parent - not to agency owners.
No calendar: the form goes straight to the thank-you and her team calls the lead back.
Copy says {agency} and {phone} where it names them; build.py writes the values in.
No phone number and no video, by choice: the 'Prefer to talk?' lines and the video box are left off.
serviceArea.zips: every Sonoma (50) and Marin (41) County ZIP per zip-codes.com, PO boxes included. 94952 Petaluma also reaches into Marin. Confirmed she covers all of both counties.

Plus 58 nearby ZIPs (added 2026-11-18): every ZIP in Napa, Lake, Mendocino, Solano, San Francisco and Contra Costa County whose Census 2020 centre point is within 15 miles of a Sonoma or Marin ZIP centre, plus 94515 Calistoga (half in Sonoma). Includes all of San Francisco and the Richmond/El Cerrito side of the Richmond-San Rafael Bridge.
Any value containing TODO blocks the build for this client only. See funnel/README.md.
theme: her logo's blue (#00349c) on white, since the logo has a white background.
